feeds.title: Women's Running
feeds.description: Women's Running focuses on women's running training advice for 5K, 10K, half marathons and marathons, female-specific kit reviews, and women's running shoe reviews. Women's Running Magazine is the UK's lifestyle magazine for women who run. The magazine has been going for more than 12 years, and in that time it has inspired thousands of women to enjoy running and to progress further than they ever thought possible.

feeds.title: RunToTheFinish Blog
feeds.description: A Researched Running Blog Designed to Help You. Amanda Brooks is an long time distance runner with a passion of every facet of running, which leads her to do more reading, research and running than necessary. Find all the tips, tricks and tools you need from this running coach for your best injury free running.

feeds.title: Another Mother Runner Blog
feeds.description: The blog covers a range of topics from how to reach a big race goal to the value of a best-running friend and everything in between. Another Mother Runner is a large, vibrant, inclusive community of female runners worldwide.

feeds.title: The Hungry Runner Girl
feeds.description: Visit my blog to read about my running, recipes and weird stories. Follow along as I share my running experiences, family adventures, love for food, my family, the highs and lows of life and tell you each and every random thought that I have.

feeds.title: Coach Debbie Runs
feeds.description: I'm Debbie. Let's chat about running. Whether it's about training, racing, or race recaps, I like nothing better than sharing my thoughts and listening to yours. I'm an RRCA certified running coach and personal trainer.

feeds.title: Carlee McDot
feeds.description: Running through life with a smile on my face!

feeds.title: The Runner Beans
feeds.description: Focuses on marathon training, running tips, recipes, nutrition advice, and kit reviews. Authored by Charlie Watson, a Registered Dietitian, author of Cook Eat Run, and thirteen-time marathoner.

feeds.title: FueledByLOLZ
feeds.description: Features running shoe guides, running stories, recipes, hiking and trail running, race recaps, shoe and gear reviews. Authored by Hollie Sick.

feeds.title: Badass Lady Gang Blog
feeds.description: A running platform for women who are redefining what strength looks like. The blog covers a range of topics from inspiring stories to running tips and tricks. Authored by Kelly Roberts.

feeds.title: Taking the Long Way Home
feeds.description: A running blog with a sprinkling of humor, aging, and rheumatoid arthritis thrown in. Written by Wendy Rivard.

feeds.title: Run With Caroline
feeds.description: Welcome to Run With Caroline - a running and fitness blog. I help people become faster, stronger, and more motivated runners.

feeds.title: MCM Mama Runs
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Erika, crazy running mom of two boys who like to keep me on my toes with their antics and schedules. I'm an adult onset runner who started running as a coping mechanism when I had postpartum depression after the birth of my first son.

feeds.title: Jill Will Run
feeds.description: Jill Whitaker is a Certified Running Coach, positive body image advocate, telecommuting web geek, and a mom. The blog is used to chronicle her running experiences, share information about running & health, review products, and promote positive body image.

feeds.title: The Runner's Plate
feeds.description: I am Michelle, and I am pretty obsessed with running. I blog about my obsession with running, healthy eating, my husband and son, and our life in Alaska. I have developed training plans, for beginning runners to novice marathoners.

feeds.title: Lazy Girl Running Blog
feeds.description: Marathon and ultra runner, triathlete, personal trainer and run coach. Loves teaching people to run. Also writes books.

feeds.title: Half Crazy Mama » Running and Races
feeds.description: Half Crazy Mama is an active mother's guide to life. Author Emelia recounts her favorite tips and insights on Running, cooking, traveling, crafting, and tales from parenthood. Dive right to explore a ton of training resources, and expert tips to make the most of your running journey.

feeds.title: Run DMT
feeds.description: From start to finish, Denise is Run DMT, a Tampa Bay marathon mom on the run trying to maintain an easy pace through it all between races and raising three beautiful, brilliant children (ages 16, 12, 7).

feeds.title: Marcia's Healthy Slice
feeds.description: Hi! Many of you may know me as Teamarcia from my previous blogs, Running Off at the Mouth and The Studly Runner. I started my web odyssey as a running blogger and as time has marched on I realized I wanted to share more with you.

feeds.title: Run Strong Run Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Stephanie, aka RunStrongRun. I am a wife, bonus mom to two teens, IVF warrior mom to a toddler, runner, educator, and lover of Jesus. It's my mission to help you find strength in running, weight loss, and living life to its fullest.

feeds.title: She Can & She Did Blog
feeds.description: She Can And She Did is storytelling platform dedicated to building a community of unapologetic, vulnerable, ambitious, diverse, and unified women by Kelly Roberts. From how to start running and funny running memes to career and family advice and body image and weight loss, sharing our stories can be an incredible vehicle for change. Meet She Can & She Did, the stronger version of the running blog Run, Selfie, Repeat.

feeds.title: Running With Music
feeds.description: A blog for runners and music lovers. Created for runners who are driven by the music they run with, for music lovers who are inspired by the music they listen to and for all of us who share this passion for running and music in any way, shape or form.

feeds.title: C Tolle Run
feeds.description: C Tolle Run is a weekly online show about running and fitness hosted by Olympian Carrie Tollefson. Watch Carrie's weekly episodes for training tips, interviews with experts in the field and highlights from races and events. Get the latest C Tolle Run episodes and behind-the-scenes moments in your news feed and find out how you can 'get after it'!

feeds.title: Racing Stripes
feeds.description: This blog is primarily dedicated to my journey as a runner. It began as a MySpace blog in 2006, which covered anything and everything, but when that platform became obsolete for blogging in 2008, I moved my running posts to this site. I started running in 2001, racing in 2005.

feeds.title: Movin' it with Michelle
feeds.description: Running, Recipes, and Real life adventures My name is Michelle and I am a retired Air Force Master Sergeant. After battling depression for many years, I have found a passion for running, cooking, writing, photography and all things that move my love for life! I've ran 3 full marathons, with a PR of 4:25, and 13 half marathons with a PR of 2:01.

feeds.title: Running With Perseverance
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Coco, a 40-something wife, mother, attorney, and runner. This blog catalogs my thoughts, experiences, struggles, and triumphs, as I try to balance everything life, throws my way with fitness and faith. Staying fit helps me get through the daily stresses of work and family, while my faith helps me handle the bigger issues.

feeds.title: Running With Attitude
feeds.description: Michelle started running in March 2010, and after a somewhat sketchy start, she eventually settled into Cool Running's Couch to 5k plan. As mom to two boys and one lovable German Shepherd, running and working out helps to provide her with much needed balance in her very busy life.

feeds.title: Dreaming Of Footpaths
feeds.description: Sarah Booker's blog is a brutally honest, amusing insight into her running adventures, which first started when she realised she was the 'fat friend' and decided to do something about it.

feeds.title: Orange Visor
feeds.description: Running, feeling good and the everyday ups and downs of this wild world we live in - all while wearing my Orange Visor!

feeds.title: Do Things Always
feeds.description: I'm Susan, originally from Scotland now transplanted to beautiful Calgary, AB. Join me for adventures in running, fitness and the great outdoors. I'm sharing my journey from 5K to ultra and way out of my comfort zone.

feeds.title: The Mother Runners
feeds.description: The Mother Runners is an informational and inspirational website for moms who run or want to run. At The Mother Runners, you'll find information for all things at the intersection of running and motherhood brought to you by my personal experiences and research, and conversations with other Mother Runners and experts.

feeds.title: Runderdog:Runleashed and Runstoppable
feeds.description: Runderdog is runleashed & runstoppable. News, views & reviews from a former gym class drop-out, who took up running decades later & never looked back

feeds.title: The Runner Doc Blog
feeds.description: Abby educates runners of all levels on how to run injury free through prevention and early intervention of problematic areas! Abby is a Doctor of Physical Therapy who loves running.

feeds.title: Run Eat Repeat
feeds.description: Running, half marathon training, diet, recipes, weight loss, fitness and more.

feeds.title: Laura Norris Running Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Laura! I'm a distance runner, RRCA certified running coach, and outdoor enthusiast living in Northwest Indiana. Whether you want to run your first race or qualify for Boston, I'm here to help you achieve your personal best with training tips and individualized run coaching.

feeds.title: Ali On The Run Blog
feeds.description: Ali On The Run is a personal blog sharing Ali Feller's running thoughts and experiences of various races and events that she's competed in, as well as featuring guest interviews.

feeds.title: Relentless Forward Commotion
feeds.description: My name is Heather Hart, I'm an ACSM certified Exercise Physiologist, UESCA & RRCA certified coach, ultrarunner, adventure racer, mom to two teenagers, and cofounder of Hart Strength & Endurance Coaching. It is my passion to help every day athletes better understand exercise science, and to learn how to balance training for big athletic goals with 'real life'.

feeds.title: Shut Up + Run
feeds.description: Beth Risdon loves to run. She discovered it 11 years ago. Like she does most things, she went from zero to 26.2 miles. No half marathons for her, no running cross country in high school. She just set her mind to it, trained, and crossed the finish line. She also loves to write. She believes in holding nothing back. She believes in telling the truth. She believes in being real.

feeds.title: Fine Fit Day » Running
feeds.description: A fit, healthy lifestyle begins today! Personal trainer and running coach Carly Pizzani shares her advice and expertise on running, strength training, and making small changes that add up to a fit, healthy happy lifestyle.

feeds.title: The Cookie ChRUNicles
feeds.description: Running through life while balancing healthy eating and single motherhood.

feeds.title: Mommy Runs It
feeds.description: Hi, Im Sharon. Welcome to Mommy Runs It! This started out as an ordinary running mom blog. You know the type : Mom meets running, Mom falls in love with running, Mom starts training for increasingly ridiculous distances, much to the bewilderment of her non-running friends and family.

feeds.title: Race Pace Jess
feeds.description: I'm Jess Underhill, a certified run coach and freelance fitness writer. My mission in life is to help people chase down their personal bests and crush their goals so that they too, can change their perceptions.

feeds.title: JogBlog
feeds.description: A light-hearted look at running, cycling and general fitness. JogBlog provides novice runners with a starting point to get them to make achievable running goals, while providing the tips, inspiration and advice that they need to push themselves.

feeds.title: Breathe Deeply and Smile
feeds.description: Running towards a happy & healthy life. A blog about the journey to happiness while balancing healthy living, good food, running,fitness and Baltimore fun.

feeds.title: Michigan Runner Girl Blog
feeds.description: Running Michigan: It's a perfect combination, don't you think? The Great Lakes State offers a perfect landscape for running and living healthy.

feeds.title: RunLadyLike
feeds.description: Jesica is a runner, triathlete and marathon coach on a mission to find my extraordinary and help you do the same.

feeds.title: Elbowglitter Blog
feeds.description: I'm Megan. I'm unmarried, in my mid 30's, and I'm a runner, triathlete, lawyer, and cat lady living in the Washington, DC area.

feeds.title: Bethany Rutledge Blog
feeds.description: Bethany is an author, athlete, and coach who writes stories about courage. Courage to Tri helps beginner triathletes train for the sprint triathlon distance.

feeds.title: Running Wife Blog
feeds.description: Running Wife is Sara's personal blog about being a runner and wife of a sub-elite runner. She has been blogging about running, love, health, and life. The blog is all about running and living life to the fullest.

feeds.title: Runnergirl Training
feeds.description: Fitness, Running & Nutrition. I am updating this blog with different facets of marathon training. The information I post is from my own training and background. I hope you find it helpful! Keep training! A blog about running, virtual races, nutrition, fitness, health and product reviews.

feeds.title: Chocolate Runs Judy
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Judy creator of Chocolaterunsjudy. Welcome to my little corner of the blogosphere, where I share my passion for running, chocolate, baking, and pretty much whatever else crosses my mind. I'm on a mission to run a half marathon in every US state & hopefully raise money for charities And to create a safe community for runners of any speed.

feeds.title: Mommy, run fast!
feeds.description: Running mom and spin instructor, passionate about feeding my family healthy, whole foods.

feeds.title: Funner Runner
feeds.description: I love to run and most importantly I love to have FUN while I run....I am the FUNNER RUNNER!

feeds.title: Alison Heilig Blog
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Alison. I help empower people to move better, get stronger, and be more resilient. I'm a coach, movement specialist, yoga teacher for athletes, | The Pursuit of Awesome

feeds.title: I Can Run Club
feeds.description: We are a women only running community. We provide beginners running sessions and free runs for women in Suffolk. We are ordinary but fabulous women keen to get others moving regardless of their age, size or ability. Our mission is to show women of all ages, sizes and backgrounds that they can run. We believe that all women have it in them to find what makes them feel epic.

feeds.title: RunYoung50
feeds.description: Run Young 50 is all about women runners over 50. Find out more about what motivates older women to run and the history of women's distance running.

feeds.title: Sweat Out The Small Stuff
feeds.description: An entertaining running blog! Break a good sweat and all of a sudden it's easier to deal with life's 'small stuff'. Don't worry! Just go for a run!

feeds.title: Running for Carbs Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Running for Carbs! My name is Tiffany and I'm just a carb loving runner with an appetite for miles and pizza. My blog focuses on the humor of life, running, eating carbs, and fitness. I hope my blog will motivate and inspire you to be active and live a healthy lifestyle.

feeds.title: Adventures of a Funatical Runner
feeds.description: Looking for fun in all the running places. My name is Lynn. I became interested in the marathon after the 1984 Summer Olympics. But it wasn't until 22 years later when a friend of mine developed an incurable form of lymphoma that I actually laced up my first running shoes. After completing my first marathon, I was hooked.

feeds.title: Barbara Curialle
feeds.description: Advice and support for women runners, age 50 to infinity.

feeds.title: The Road Less Run
feeds.description: My name is Angela. I am distance runner, a self proclaimed dream chaser & a believer in serendipity. I live in the Colorado mountains, but I am originally from New Jersey. My blog is called The Road Less Run because I am a runner who doesn't do things the traditional way.

feeds.title: Two Running Sisters
feeds.description: Hello, and welcome to our blog! We are two sisters who love to run. This blog is a record of our training and races, and maybe a little of our lives outside of running too.

feeds.title: Organic Girl's Blog
feeds.description: My Life..My Words.. I'm Lisa! I've been running since June 2012, a vegetarian since April 2010. Being eco friendly and organic are very important to me. I also love walking running for charities, biking for fun, attending local music events, art festivals and traveling.

feeds.title: Turning 40 so let's RUN
feeds.description: In 2013 I turned 40.I gave up cigarettes ran a half marathon and became a Runner! A blog about becoming a runner. About the running adventures my running group RIOT runners and I have in Killarney, Co. Kerry and beyond.

feeds.title: Living the Dream
feeds.description: I come from a long line of champion chip eaters and running is my addiction. I am working hard to stay fit through another pregnancy! This blog is my adventure as a running mom eating as clean as I can and inspiring others along the way!

feeds.title: The Long Slow Distance
feeds.description: The Long Slow Distance follows the training of Amy Friel, a Canadian distance runner and freelance writer. The daughter of a nationally-ranked middle-distance runner and granddaughter of a Canadian marathon legend, Amy's writing chronicles the personal journey of a young athlete struggling to make good on her family's storied marathon legacy.

feeds.title: Running, Loving, Living
feeds.description: My name is Toni and I am a mother, wife, runner, blogger and RN originally from Long Island. I now reside in Tampa Bay. I blog about running, health, fitness and my life.

feeds.title: Through Heather's Looking Glass » Running
feeds.description: Hi! Welcome to my page! My name is Heather Montgomery. All posts in this area of my blog have to do with running. It may be pictures, stories, experiences, or race recaps that I am sharing.

feeds.title: Veggie Runners
feeds.description: Mother and Daughter, Janey and Bibi, writing delicious veggie recipes for fuelling your life, along with training tips and running tales.

feeds.title: Women's Running
feeds.description: Focuses on running, fitness, nutrition, and wellness to the ever-growing community of women runners. Women's Running is the favorite website and magazine for women who love to run.

feeds.title: Runs for Cookies
feeds.description: In August 2009, I went on a mission to lose 100 pounds. I lost 125 pounds in 16 months, and now I'm doing my best to keep it off. Unwilling to give up my love affair with cookies, I became a runner along the way, hoping to achieve a nice balance.

feeds.title: Run Lift Balance -
feeds.description: Covers articles about the balance of running and weight training. Also includes Lauren's personal journal, personal training log, as well as, workouts and articles all things running.

feeds.title: Inspired to Run
feeds.description: Kristin, a distance runner who loves trail running, shares running related tips and tricks, recipes and where she is running to next!
